verdict.rationale: Devin is explicitly designed to be operated via natural-language commands—tagging it in Slack/Teams, delegating tickets, terminal/CLI prompts, and MCP slash commands all rely on NL input—showing broad agentic, conversational control across surfaces (docs, CLI, IDE, API). However, community evidence questions the reliability of its autonomous execution (13.8% issue resolution rate, brittle fixes like try-catch patching, skepticism about whether it truly acts as an 'AI engineer'), indicating the NL command interface works but outcomes are inconsistent.
